name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Shadowcrafting) — 3 Advanced — Abyssal Pact

system.description:
Within total darkness shared with your target, you conjure a hungry shade of tangible shadow. Making a Simple Test, a win inflicts two levels of lethal damage and the Negative Physical Trait Sickly on your victim, a tie inflicts one level of lethal damage, and a loss turns the shade against you for one level of lethal damage instead. Alternately, you can pit the shade in a Mental Challenge against an Obtenebration user to unravel that power outright, though the Obtenebration wielder gets a free retest to resist. Either use costs five Blood Traits total.

This path does not function against or for Kindred with the Flaw: Cast No Reflection.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
